recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. Future resource-guide staleness should be handled by targeted current issues rather than reopening this broad 2015 placeholder request.
issue_request: FHIR-7290 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core 2015 May ballot request against resourceguide.html section 3.1. It noted that the page only said it would eventually provide an overview of FHIR resources and asked for actual content; the resolution and comments say the work was done or being completed under another task.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly mentions FHIR-7290. Git history shows commit 014e9d1754 replaced the placeholder text in source/resourceguide.html with substantive guide content in August 2015, followed by 7524d34ddd and bb5e3f2a9f expanding and drafting the guide/common-concepts table during the same application window.
additional_context: FHIR-7477 was a same-page 2015 Guide to Resources completion request and is already audited on the combined branch. Later resource-guide issues changed how the current page should be interpreted: FHIR-13042 removed the old detailed Resource Classification section in favor of pattern links, and FHIR-43371 clarified the current page intent and made targeted content updates. The page is active through publish.ini and source/hierarchy.xml and is linked from documentation, modules, and resource-list pages.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source/resourceguide.html already contains an active Guide to Resources page with introductory guidance, common clinical concept mappings, and Resource Patterns links, so the original missing-content problem is no longer present.
